title: Activation inventory
idea: Activation inventory: Unclaimed assigned and revoked tags form separate inventory states
audience: People who need to assign tag within a dashboard surface.
worksWellWhen: Physical tags and digital entitlements differ
avoidWhen: A QR identifier can be guessed sequentially
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic ledger layout through its assign tag priority and explicit commitment contract: Atomic assignment prevents duplicate ownership
navigation: Activation inventory keeps the current assign tag context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Unclaimed assigned and revoked tags form separate inventory states
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to assign tag; physical tags and digital entitlements differ

imagery.role: Support the actual assign tag context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Prioritize token-safe label and assignment status
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the activation inventory structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no assign tag content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Atomic assignment prevents duplicate ownership
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized assign tag content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active assign tag context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
